lines: CLIA Laboratories | Health and Human Services North Dakota

Laboratories in North Dakota are certified as meeting the requirements of the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments, CLIA, of 1988. Certification in the CLIA program allows for Medicare and Medicaid reimbursement for lab services in the nearly 900 entities in the state of North Dakota that do some type of lab test.
